compiled_state.title: qualify-skill-refs.sh edits plugin cache on host project (no-edit-plugin-cache violation)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Summary
plugins/dso/scripts/qualify-skill-refs.sh line 28 sets
  REPO_ROOT=\"\$(cd \"\$SCRIPT_DIR/..\" && pwd)\"

This is the same construction as the check-skill-refs.sh sibling bug (34b2), but worse because qualify-skill-refs.sh is a MUTATOR — it rewrites /skill -> /dso:skill across host CLAUDE.md, docs, and skill files. On a host project invocation via the shim, REPO_ROOT resolves to the plugin cache root, so the script edits files in the plugin cache (violating rule:no-edit-plugin-cache from CLAUDE.md) and the host's actual files are never qualified.

## Reproduction
1. Install DSO plugin on a host project.
2. Host CLAUDE.md contains unqualified /skill references.
3. Run \`.claude/scripts/dso qualify-skill-refs.sh\`.
4. Observe: host files unchanged; plugin cache files modified (likely diff visible in plugin cache git status if user navigates there).

## Fix
Replace line 28 with:
  REPO_ROOT=\"\${PROJECT_ROOT:-\$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}\"
Hard-error on empty REPO_ROOT.

Also verify that all subsequent path constructions (skill enumeration vs scan targets) correctly distinguish \$_PLUGIN_ROOT (plugin-shipped resources) from \$REPO_ROOT (host files to mutate).

## Discovered by
Opus audit subagent on 2026-05-28 during PR-4 host-portability review.
